title: FIPS subscriber + domain foundation (Phase A.1)
observed_behavior_before: Bahia had no FIPS config section.
Worker domain records had no fields for FIPS overlay address or transport endpoints.
DNS domain constants did not include mesh endpoint family or mesh zone visibility.
intended_behavior: Bahia exposes FIPS config defaults for disabled-by-default overlay advert ingestion.
Workers can carry a derived FIPS fd00::/8 overlay address and advertised FIPS transport endpoints.
DNS domain constants recognize mesh endpoint family and mesh zone visibility.

A self-contained FIPS subscriber subscribes to Kind 37195 with a narrow d-tag filter, validates inbound Nostr events, parses OverlayAdvert JSON, matches workers by pubkey, derives overlay IPv6 addresses, and applies updates through the worker repository without app.go wiring.
